svg.title: stdx's DEFLATE against its baselines, on Neoverse-N2
svg.desc: gzip decoding, in multiples of libdeflate's speed: ahead on 31, level on 2, behind on 6 of 39 files; 0.92 to 1.71. gzip encoding: speed in multiples of libdeflate's level 6, against compression ratio: no other library's point is both faster and smaller than any of stdx's 3 levels.
svg.text: stdx's DEFLATE against its baselines, on Neoverse-N2
One job of run 44677292221 at commit 0dd2e97. The line at 1 is the baseline each panel's title names; the axis is logarithmic.
gzip decoding, in multiples of libdeflate's speed
ahead on 31, level on 2, behind on 6 of 39 files; 0.92 to 1.71
gzip encoding: speed in multiples of libdeflate's level 6, against compression ratio
no other library's point is both faster and smaller than any of stdx's 3 levels
The number beside a point is its level. Up is smaller output, and right is faster.
† the benchmark repeats this file of 256 KiB or less, so the branch predictor learns it (decision 45)
